text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Political parties, independent candidates intensify activities in first week of campaigning for June 5 parliamentary elections.
- Security forces step up "anti-terrorist" operations while three explosions kill 19 people.
- Conflicting proposals by candidates from same parties during campaign suggest that many parties may have no precise programmes to face political and economic challenges.
